entries.title: Isaiah 31:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The prophet shews the folly and danger of trusting to Egypt, and forsaking God. 6 He exhorts to conversion. 8 He shews the fall of Assyria.

to them. 30:1-7; 36:6; 57:9; Eze 17:15; Ho 11:5 stay on horses. 30:16; 36:9; De 17:16; Ps 20:7; 33:16,17 the look. 5:12; 17:7,8; 22:11; 2Ch 16:7; Jer 2:13; 17:5; Ho 14:3 neither. 9:13; 64:7; Da 9:13; Ho 7:7,13-16; Am 5:4-8

entries.title: Isaiah 31:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
birds. 10:14; Ex 19:4; De 32:11; Ps 46:5; 91:4 defending. Ps 37:40 passing.Or rather, as Bp. Lowth renders, "leaping forward," {pasoach.} As the mother bird spreads her wings to cover her young, throws herself before them, and opposes the rapacious bird that assaults them; so shall Jehovah protect, as with a shield, Jerusalem from the enemy, protecting and delivering, springing forward and rescuing her.

Ex 12:27

entries.title: Isaiah 31:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: in that. 2:20; 30:22; De 7:25; Eze 36:25; Ho 14:8 his idols of gold. Heb. the idols of his gold. for a sin. 1Ki 12:28-30; Ho 8:11

entries.title: Isaiah 31:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: shall the. 10:16-19,33,34; 14:25; 29:5; 30:27-33; 37:35; 2Ki 19:34-37 2Ch 32:21; Ho 1:7 he shall flee. 37:37,38 from the sword. or, for fear of the sword. discomfited.or, tributary. Heb. for melting, or tribute.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear. Heb. hisrock shall pass away for fear. or, his strength. the ensign. 11:10; 18:3 whose fire. 4:4; 29:6; Le 6:13; Eze 22:18-22; Zec 2:5; Mal 4:1
